en.html: After several stalls, we sat on a bench. Navigating the crowd had tired my legs.

　人込みの中を泳いで回ったせいで、それなりに足は

en.html:
Muramasa"Whew."
Kageaki"Kept you company too long."
Muramasa"I enjoyed it too. Similar shops all the way, though."
Kageaki"Yes. That kind of shop... An antique shop."
Kageaki"As a child, I dreamed of running one when I grew up."
Muramasa"Did you?"
Kageaki"Long ago... But a childhood dream stays in the chest."

en.html:
Kageaki"All day in a dim shop, breathing musty air, polishing a Wanli jar... Yes. That was the life I longed for."
Muramasa"...O-oh..."
Kageaki"Never came true."
Muramasa"You don't know that."
Kageaki"...?"
Muramasa"Could begin now."
Kageaki"..."
Kageaki"I see. ...Yes..."
Muramasa"Yes."
Kageaki"...And you?"
Muramasa"Eh?"
Kageaki"Any childhood dream?"
Muramasa"...I was born where I was."
Muramasa"Born into an Emishi smith's house, you don't imagine a future other than becoming a tsurugi."
Kageaki"I see..."

Muramasa"Well... Not absolutely nothing."
Kageaki"There was one?"
Muramasa"Something I thought would be nice. Just a little. When I was small..."
Muramasa"Heard court ladies wore beautiful clothes every day. Once I said I wanted to become one."
Muramasa"...Mother heard. Scolded me thoroughly..."
Kageaki"A court lady."

Muramasa"Even with connections to become a court lady, I would have chosen a tsurugi."
Kageaki"..."
Muramasa"Becoming a tsurugi let me meet you."
Muramasa"Perhaps chance brought us together... But two months ago, you—"
Muramasa"You said you needed me. Didn't you?"

What was this feeling?
Trying to steady myself, I looked away.

en.html:
Muramasa"What's wrong?"
Kageaki"Nothing."
Muramasa"A little odd."
Kageaki"Not at all."
Muramasa"What are you thinking?"
Kageaki"Nothing particular."
Muramasa"Really?"
Kageaki"...What?"
Muramasa"Perhaps I'll read it through mental interference."
Kageaki"Do not."
Muramasa"Joking. You'll tell me without that, won't you?"
Kageaki"...Ah..."
Kageaki"..."
Muramasa"Trying to evade it."
Kageaki"Ah... Yes. Our earlier discussion."
Muramasa"Earlier?"
Kageaki"Court ladies."
Muramasa"Enough about that."
Kageaki"I cannot send you into court. But... perhaps I could offer something like it. A simulated experience."
Muramasa"...? What do you mean?"
Kageaki"An idea."
